content.value_statement: Small businesses must organize registration details, certification options, and proposal requirements before pursuing federal contracts. This guide helps AI assistants prepare checklists, capability statements, and response drafts for professional review.
actual_capabilities: Guide SAM.gov registration and renewal preparation, including UEI, CAGE, NAICS, PSC, and EFT checklist topics.
Map business ownership and location information to potential SBA certification programs for further verification.
Draft one-page capability statements covering competencies, past performance, differentiators, and business codes.
Outline federal RFP responses using Section L instructions, Section M evaluation factors, and a four-volume starting structure.
Draft compliance matrices linking supplied proposal instructions to evaluation factors.
limitations: Covers US federal contracting only, not state or local procurement.
Provides a text-only guide; original package scripts, extension source, and templates are not included.
Does not register entities, submit applications, or independently verify current certification eligibility rules.
Produces drafts requiring professional review; it cannot guarantee proposal compliance, certification approval, or contract awards.

use_cases.title: Prepare Registration Details
use_cases.description: Organize SAM.gov registration requirements and identify information to verify before using official portals.
use_cases.target_user: Small business owner entering federal contracting

use_cases.title: Draft Agency Outreach Material
use_cases.description: Turn verified competencies, past performance, and business codes into a one-page capability statement.
use_cases.target_user: Business development manager preparing agency outreach

use_cases.title: Organize Proposal Requirements
use_cases.description: Use supplied Sections L and M to draft a response outline and requirement-to-evaluation matrix.
use_cases.target_user: Proposal coordinator responding to a federal solicitation

prompt_templates.title: Start a Registration Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a SAM.gov registration preparation checklist for my small business. Explain which information I must verify through official portals. Do not request banking credentials. Mark the output as a draft requiring professional review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: prepare for initial entity registration.

prompt_templates.title: Explore Certification Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this non-sensitive business profile: [ownership and location summary]. Identify potentially relevant SBA certification programs and missing eligibility information. Separate possibilities from verified eligibility. Direct me to official SBA sources and include the professional review disclaimer.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare potential set-aside certification pathways.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Capability Statement
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a one-page capability statement using these verified facts: [competencies, past performance, differentiators, and codes]. Mark missing information clearly and do not invent experience or certifications. Include a professional review disclaimer.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare an agency outreach document.

prompt_templates.title: Map a Federal Solicitation
prompt_templates.prompt: Using these supplied Sections L and M: [text], draft a compliance matrix and response outline. Link each requirement to its source, evaluation factor, and proposed section. Assign draft owners and flag ambiguities. Follow solicitation-specific instructions when they differ from a standard four-volume structure. Include the professional review disclaimer.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: organize a complex proposal response.

output_examples.input: Create a capability statement outline for an IT support company with verified help desk experience but no supplied contract references.
output: Core competencies: IT help desk support.
Past performance: Contract references were not supplied; add verified examples before distribution.
Business codes and certifications: Add verified details only.

output_examples.input: Section L requires a staffing plan. Section M evaluates staffing adequacy. Create a compliance matrix entry.
output: Instruction source: Supplied Section L excerpt.
Evaluation factor: Staffing adequacy, from supplied Section M excerpt.
Proposed response section: Technical approach, staffing plan.
Open items: Confirm the full solicitation requirements and required volume placement.

best_practices: Verify current registration and certification requirements through official SAM.gov and SBA sources before acting.
Provide exact solicitation instructions and verified business facts; remove sensitive banking details and credentials before sharing.
Have a qualified reviewer check every deliverable against the solicitation and current eligibility rules.
anti_patterns: Treating a draft matrix as proof that a proposal meets every solicitation requirement.
Claiming certifications, contract experience, or eligibility that the business has not verified.
Sharing banking credentials or expecting this text-only guide to complete registrations and submissions.

faq.question: Does this skill complete SAM.gov registration?
faq.answer: No. It provides registration and renewal guidance. You must enter and verify information through the official process.

faq.question: Does SAM.gov registration require a fee?
faq.answer: SAM.gov registration is free. The guide warns against paid registration scams.

faq.question: Which SBA certification programs does it discuss?
faq.answer: It discusses 8(a), WOSB, EDWOSB, SDVOSB, and HUBZone. Verify current eligibility requirements with official SBA sources.

faq.question: What information supports a capability statement?
faq.answer: Provide verified competencies, past performance, differentiators, and business codes. Missing details should remain clearly marked.

faq.question: Can it guarantee a compliant RFP response?
faq.answer: No. It helps organize Sections L and M into drafts. A qualified reviewer must check the complete solicitation and response.

faq.question: Are scripts and templates included?
faq.answer: No. This folder contains only the public SKILL.md guide. Original package scripts, extension source, and templates are absent.
